'''The Tipsy Mynock''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karfeddion/Legends|Karfeddion]]. Its owners and patrons were great fans of the local [[Smashball/Legends|smashball]] team, the [[Skull Crackers]]. The [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Lope (individual)|Lope]] often visited the Tipsy Mynock when he was on-planet.<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>
